The skill of pranks is an amusing mish-mash of acrobatic abilities, strange-and-amusing abilities involving props like balloons, mice, and jack-in-the-boxes, and the science of bomb-making. Practiced solely by Jesters, these abilities even include some seriously bad jokes, and even the ability to scrawl graffiti on city walls.

The skill of '''Pranks''' is available to members of the [[Jester]] [[class]], along with [[Tarot]] and [[Puppetry]].

==Abilities in Pranks==

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Props

 |lessons=

When doing so, the gold cost and balance use will be multiplied.

{{Skill_detail

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Hocuspocus
 |description=Cast coloured illusions to dazzle those about you.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=HOCUSPOCUS <delay in seconds> COLOUR <color> <illusion message><br>HOCUSPOCUS <delay in seconds> <illusion message>
 |required=1 mana per character
 |target=Room
 |cooldown=3.00 seconds of equilibrium
 |detail=This ability lets you set off coloured, delayed illusions. The colours available to you can be seen at the bottom of CONFIG COLOUR, with the exception of 15, which you may not use. The cost in mana is one mana for each character in the illusion. You may embed a single newline in an illusion by inserting the character sequence \n at the appropriate spot. For restrictions and limitations, please refer to HELP ILLUSIONS. 
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Balancing
 |description=Maintain superior balance.

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Envenom
 |description=Coat a weapon in venoms.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=ENVENOM <weapon> with <venom><br>WIPE <weapon>
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=With this ability, you may layer venoms on an edged weapon. Each time that weapon hits somebody, one venom will poison your opponent, and disappear from the weapon. They work on a last-on, first-off basis, so if you put xentio on a weapon, and then put voyria on, the voyria would come off first, and the xentio second. You must have the selected venom in a vial in your inventory. In order to get rid of the venoms on a weapon, simply WIPE <weapon>.
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Smokebomb
 |description=Choke all in the room with a plume of smoke.

 |cooldown=4.00 seconds of balance
 |detail=This bomb, when it explodes, will spew out a foul gas that will choke those in the room. The fumes induce hunger in those that inhale them. You can make two bombs out of a single commodity.
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Juggling
 |description=The ancient art of juggling.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=JUGGLE <item1> [item2] [item3]<br>JUGGLED<br>JUGGLE STOP
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=1.00 seconds of balance
 |detail=You may juggle up to two items at once, or three if you have reached Transcendent pranks. Once you are juggling, you may throw the items you're juggling at a greatly decreased cost in balance. JUGGLED will show you what, if anything, you are juggling. Be aware that juggling comes with an endurance drain and, no matter how nimble your fingers, you are not adept enough to juggle bombs. 
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Vent

 |required=

{{Skill_detail

 |lessons=
 |syntax=BADJOKE

 |cooldown=2.00 seconds of balance

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Disarm
 |description=Attempt to disarm a trap.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=DISARM <trap type> <direction>

 |target=Room

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Itchpowder

 |lessons=

}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Dustbomb
 |description=Numb the sense of your victims with a bomb.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=CONSTRUCT DUST BOMB<br>THROW BOMB <direction>/AT GROUND
 |required=1 diamond dust

 |cooldown=4.00 seconds of balance
 |detail=This ability will cause a cloud of dust to go up, cutting off much sensory input for a time. You can make two bombs out of a single commodity.
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Jackinthebox
 |description=An innocent musical toy with a vicious bite!
 |lessons=
 |syntax=CONSTRUCT JACK-IN-THE-BOX<br>WIND JACK-IN-THE-BOX FOR <target>
 |required=1 iron and 1 wood
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=Construct: 4.00 seconds of balance<br>Wind: 2.00 seconds of balance
 |detail=With this ability, you may construct a jack-in-the-box that, when wound and targetted for a specific person (see syntax above), will kill that person when the puppet pops out, assuming the target is still in the room. You may not do anything else while you wind the jack-in-the-box.
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Timers
 |description=Give your bombs a delayed effect.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=TIMER <bomb> <3-60 seconds>
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=0.50 seconds of balance
 |detail=By setting a timer on a bomb, you are able to delay its effect. Be warned though, that once a timer has been set, a bomb cannot be picked up again.
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Gallowshumour
 |description=A tough crowd, this one.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=GALLOWSHUMOUR <target>
 |required=
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=2.10 seconds of balance
 |detail=Sometimes the infamous greyfaces need a bit of a different approach to coax out a smile. If wielding a puppet of one such poor soul, you may enlighten him or her with some good old gallows humour, adding some real character to his face in the process(*). Even then, you might need to soften them up a bit first(**).<p>If used against a denizen, this skill does not require a puppet and behaves differently. With your morbid humour, you will inflict psychic damage upon the target. The closer they are to death, the sharper your wit cuts(***).<p>* This will improve the fashioned state of your puppet.<br>** The more afflictions the target has, the more fashions you will receive. They will require at least two and several things are excluded: broken limbs, writhe afflictions, and anything with a nonstandard cure such as time.<br>*** You will deal increased damage to denizens under 50% health. This bonus increases on denizens below 25% health.</br>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Suicidemice
 |description=Brainwash mice to carry bombs on their backs.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=TIE CHEESE TO ROPE<br>FISH FOR MICE<br>REEL IN MOUSE<br>EDUCATE MOUSE<br>STRAP <bomb> TO <mouse><br>ORDER MOUSE KILL <target><br>CALL MICE
 |required=
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=Educate: 5.00 seconds of balance<br>Strap: 4.00 seconds of balance
 |detail=Brainwash mice until they are willing to sacrifice their lives for you. First, get a rope and cheese, and then tie the rope to the cheese. Then, you have to fish for the mice in a city area. Reel the mouse in when one bites. Once you've caught one, you may educate him, which will prepare the mouse for use. Just strap a bomb onto his back, drop him, and ORDER MOUSE KILL <whoever>. If you are within approximately 10 rooms of your target, the mouse will immediately take off chasing your unlucky victim, and, upon finding the person, detonate the bomb.
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Liberate
 |description=They weren't using it anyway.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=LIBERATE TONGUE OF <target>
 |required=
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=3.60 seconds of balance
 |detail=Once you've got a good idea of how someone's wagging their tongue, you can grab that beauty right out of their mouth*. You'll need to get it just right though, so it'll take some observing.<p>Once someone is afflicted with stuttering, each time they communicate** you'll get a better idea of what you need. Once you've observed enough***, the rest is up to you!</p><p>* Yes, they die. Tragic but what can you do.<br>** Any form of communication triggers this, as well as the puppet tickle ability. Laughter might not be the best medicine in this case.<br>*** You'll need to observe four times to be able to liberate their tongue.</p>
}}
